#include <vector>
#include <string>

// A plain function exercising if/elif/else, &&, || and the ternary.
int classify(int score, bool bonus) {
    if (score > 90) {
        return 4;
    } else if (score > 75 && bonus) {
        return 3;
    } else if (score > 50 || bonus) {
        return 2;
    }
    return score > 0 ? 1 : 0;
}

#if defined(FEATURE_X)
// A whole preprocessor-guarded function, including its own #if bump.
int feature_x_value() {
    if (FEATURE_X_STRICT) {
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
#endif

#ifdef LEGACY_LOOP
int legacy_total(int n) {
    return n;
}
#elif defined(NEW_LOOP)
int new_total(int n) {
    return n * 2;
}
#endif

// for / switch-case / while, exercising every control-flow condition token
// except catch (there is no exception handling in this file).
int loop_and_switch(int n) {
    int total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        switch (i % 3) {
            case 0:
                total += 1;
                break;
            case 1:
                total += 2;
                break;
            default:
                total += 3;
        }
    }
    while (total > 100 && n > 0) {
        total -= n;
        n--;
    }
    return total;
}

// A preprocessor conditional written INSIDE a function's body -- unlike the
// two guards above (which sit between functions, at global scope, and so
// bump a condition nobody ever reads), this one lands on a real function's
// counter while it is current.
int guarded_body(int n) {
#if defined(STRICT_MODE)
    if (n < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
#endif
    return n;
}

int try_catch_example(int n) {
    try {
        if (n < 0) {
            throw n;
        }
    } catch (int e) {
        return -1;
    }
    return n;
}
